title: Aesthetically pleasing and compact.. not for hefty jobs!
text:
Aesthetically pleasing and compact.. not for hefty jobs!. Looks great and keeps bathroom tidy and prepped for cleaning or emergencies in the nicest of ways! The fact is a bathroom needs a plunger (or easy access to one) without it.. Well, we’ve all been there!

There’s an issue in fact this must be assembled bc where ever parts must come together.. they can also come apart in the most inconvenient of ways!! That’s the issue with this plunger- if you’re not careful, you can plunge the suction cup right off the handle and there’s only one way to get it back.. not ok! This could work in its capacity.. IF you had a clamp or device to keep plunger cap from slipping off handle- we worked to figure one out!! (using a metal clamp with screw twist tightening key..a step we shouldn’t need to do or solve- only we wanted a solution!) Had I known prior to ordering, I would not have chose.. but bc we liked the compact and discrete aesthetics, and had already put it to use- we got creative!

As for the brush: make certain all connections are 110% tightened/secure- if not, as you clean.. the brush may loosen as well! All obstacles could be avoided if received in larger box already assembled with solid pieces- it would be worth the few extra dollars to get this type of quality + peace of mind.

I’d recommend as a back up solution.. or secondary plunger. Maybe you’ll have better luck keeping in place?! Be certain to do more then finger tighten any connections prior to use to avoid mishaps! After all, this tidies up bathroom essentials that can otherwise be an eyesore!! Hoping info may help your decision- stay safe everyone.
